2.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.

3.text: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

4.text: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.<sup foot_note="227420">1</sup>

footnotes.227420: - i.e., they would be compelled to believe.

5.text: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

6.text: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

7.text: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

8.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

9.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

10.text: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

11.text: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"

12.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

13.text: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

14.text: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

15.text: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

16.text: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers<sup foot_note="227421">1</sup> of the Lord of the worlds,

footnotes.227421: - The singular form in Arabic indicates that both were sent with a single message.

17.text: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

18.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

19.text: And [then] you did your deed which you did,<sup foot_note="227422">1</sup> and you were of the ungrateful."

footnotes.227422: - i.e., striking the Copt, who died as a result.

20.text: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].

21.text: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophethood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

22.text: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"

23.text: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

24.text: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."

25.text: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

26.text: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

27.text: [Pharaoh] said,<sup foot_note="227423">1</sup> "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

28.text: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

29.text: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

30.text: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"

31.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

32.text: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.<sup foot_note="227424">1</sup>

33.text: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

34.text: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

35.text: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

36.text: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

37.text: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

38.text: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.<sup foot_note="227425">1</sup>

footnotes.227425: - i.e., the morning of the day of festival.  See 20:58-59.

39.text: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

40.text: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

41.text: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

42.text: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

43.text: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

44.text: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

45.text: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

46.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

47.text: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

48.text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

49.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

50.text: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

51.text: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

52.text: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

53.text: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers<sup foot_note="227426">1</sup>

footnotes.227426: - Recruiters of an army to prevent the emigration of the Children of Israel.

54.text: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

55.text: And indeed, they are enraging us,

56.text: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."

57.text: So We removed them from gardens and springs

58.text: And treasures and honorable station<sup foot_note="227427">1</sup> -

footnotes.227427: - Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) caused them to abandon their wealth and property in pursuit of the Israelites.

59.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

60.text: So they pursued them at sunrise.

61.text: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

62.text: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

63.text: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

64.text: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].

65.text: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

67.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

68.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

69.text: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

70.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

71.text: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

72.text: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

73.text: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

74.text: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

75.text: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

77.text: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,<sup foot_note="227428">1</sup>

footnotes.227428: - The people worshipped idols in addition to Allāh.

78.text: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

79.text: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

80.text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

81.text: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

82.text: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

83.text: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

84.text: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.

85.text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

86.text: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

87.text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

88.text: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

89.text: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."

90.text: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

91.text: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

92.text: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

93.text: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"

94.text: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators

95.text: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

96.text: They will say while they dispute therein,

97.text: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error

98.text: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

99.text: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

100.text: So now we have no intercessors

102.text: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."<sup foot_note="227429">1</sup>

footnotes.227429: - The conclusion of this verse is estimated as "...we would do this or that."

103.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

104.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

105.text: The people of Noah denied the messengers<sup foot_note="227430">1</sup>

106.text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

107.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

108.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

109.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

110.text: So fear Allāh and obey me."

111.text: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

112.text: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

113.text: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

114.text: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

115.text: I am only a clear warner."

116.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

117.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

118.text: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

119.text: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

120.text: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

121.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

122.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

124.text: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

125.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

126.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

127.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

128.text: Do you construct on every elevation a sign,<sup foot_note="227431">1</sup> amusing yourselves,

footnotes.227431: - i.e., a symbol or indication of their wealth and power.  They used to build lofty structures along the road to be seen by all who passed by.

129.text: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?

130.text: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

131.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

132.text: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

133.text: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

135.text: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

136.text: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

137.text: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

138.text: And we are not to be punished."

139.text: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

140.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

142.text: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

143.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

144.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

145.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

146.text: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

148.text: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

149.text: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

150.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

151.text: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

152.text: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

153.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

154.text: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

155.text: He said, "This is a she-camel.<sup foot_note="227432">1</sup> For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

footnotes.227432: - Miraculously sent to them as a sign by Allāh.

156.text: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

157.text: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

158.text: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

159.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

160.text: The people of Lot denied the messengers

161.text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

162.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

163.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

164.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

165.text: Do you approach males among the worlds<sup foot_note="227433">1</sup>

footnotes.227433: - i.e., Are there, out of all Allāh's creatures, any besides you who commit this unnatural act?

166.text: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

167.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."

168.text: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].

169.text: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."

170.text: So We saved him and his family, all,

171.text: Except an old woman<sup foot_note="227434">1</sup> among those who remained behind.

footnotes.227434: - Lot's wife, who had collaborated with the evildoers.

173.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

174.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

175.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

176.text: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers

177.text: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

178.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

179.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

180.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

181.text: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

182.text: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.

183.text: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

184.text: And fear He who created you and the former creation."<sup foot_note="227435">1</sup>

185.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

186.text: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

187.text: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."

188.text: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

189.text: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

190.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

191.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

192.text: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

193.text: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down

194.text: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners

196.text: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

197.text: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

198.text: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners<sup foot_note="227436">1</sup>

footnotes.227436: - i.e., the non-Arabs or those who are not fluent in the Arabic language.

199.text: And he had recited it to them [perfectly],<sup foot_note="227437">1</sup> they would [still] not have been believers in it.

200.text: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.

201.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.

202.text: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

203.text: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

204.text: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

205.text: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

206.text: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

207.text: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

208.text: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

209.text: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

210.text: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.<sup foot_note="227438">1</sup>

footnotes.227438: - As was asserted by the disbelievers.  Rather, it was brought by Gabriel, the Trustworthy Spirit.

211.text: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

212.text: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.<sup foot_note="227439">1</sup>

213.text: So do not invoke<sup foot_note="227440">1</sup> with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.

214.text: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.

215.text: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.

216.text: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

217.text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

218.text: Who sees you when you arise<sup foot_note="227441">1</sup>

footnotes.227441: - From your bed at night for prayer while you are alone.

219.text: And your movement among those who prostrate.<sup foot_note="227442">1</sup>

footnotes.227442: - i.e., among those who pray with you in congregation.

220.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

221.text: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

222.text: They descend upon every sinful liar.

223.text: They pass on what is heard,<sup foot_note="227443">1</sup> and most of them are liars.

footnotes.227443: - This was before they were prevented, as described in 72:8-9.

224.text: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them.

225.text: Do you not see that in every valley they roam<sup foot_note="227444">1</sup>

footnotes.227444: - Speaking lies indiscriminately and praising and disparaging others according to whim.

226.text: And that they say what they do not do? -

227.text: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims]<sup foot_note="227445">1</sup> after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.

footnotes.227445: - By replying through poetry to the attacks of hostile poets.
